title: Free Pizza
description: Outside a church, Grandma proudly tells someone on the phone that her grandson has been going to Bible study every week. Pa notices the church sign advertising free pizza and has a pretty good idea why.
alt: Outside a church, Grandma smiles proudly while talking on her phone and says, 'He’s been going to Bible study every week!' Pa stands beside her looking knowingly at a church sign that reads 'BIBLE STUDY' and 'FREE PIZZA.' Pa replies, 'Yeah. I think I know why.'
